programme.desc: காணாமல்போன தன் மனைவியை பற்றி விசாரிக்கும் ஒரு போலீஸ், அவள் கற்பழிக்கப்பட்டு கொல்லப்பட்டதை அறிந்து பழிவாங்க தொடங்கினார்.

programme.title: நாயகி
programme.desc: ஒரு ஊரில் மக்கள் தொடர்ந்து காணாமல் போகும்போது, அதன் பின்னணியை கண்டறிய, ஊருக்குள் நுழைவதை கட்டுப்படுத்தும் அரசாங்கம்.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: ஒயிட் உல்ஃவ்ஸ்: கோஸ்ட்ஸ் ஆஃப் த ஆர்ட்டிக்
programme.desc: ஆர்க்டிக்கில் வெள்ளை ஓநாய்களின் கூட்டத்தின் பயணத்தையும் அதன் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்கான சவால்களையும் ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: Dethroned
programme.desc: For thousands of years, big cats were revered as gods and symbols of power. Today, habitat loss and cultural distance threaten their survival, pushing humanity's ancient bond with these predators to a breaking point.

programme.title: தி சீக்ரட் லைஃப் ஆஃப் தி ஹெர்மிட் கிராப்
programme.desc: குவாடலூப்பிலுள்ள ஹெர்மிட் நண்டுகளின் வாழ்வில் ஆராய்ந்து, முட்டைகளை கடலில் விடுவதற்காக 3 கி.மீ இடம்பெயர்வு பயணிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்
programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: ஐபீரியன் வைப்பர்ஸ்
programme.desc: ஐபீரிய தீபகற்பத்தில் உள்ள விஷ பாம்புகளின் நடத்தை, பண்புகள் மற்றும் உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகளை ஆராயும் திரைப்பட தயாரிப்பாளர்.

programme.title: அ கேம் ஆஃப் லெப்பர்ட் த்ரோன்ஸ்

programme.title: The Odd Couple
programme.desc: When their respective marriages fall apart, endearing slob Oscar Madison invites his former college friend Felix Unger to move in with him. Right away it becomes obvious that Felix's uptight, neat-freak ways are at odds with his habits, so Oscar worries he has made an enormous mistake, but together they decide that -- whatever their differences -- they can help each other move on from their divorces, make the living arrangement work and, possibly, learn a little more about themselves in the process.

programme.title: The Fighterman Singham 2
programme.desc: When a happy-go-lucky policeman accidentally detains a man who is actually a wanted gangster, he finds himself in a big dilemma.

programme.title: Hidimbha
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, a series of murders targets young girls. Later, officers Aadhya and Abhay investigate as more victims disappear, soon discovering a common link among them.

programme.title: Bazaar
programme.desc: Kalki dreams of becoming a pigeon racing champion. However, his life takes a turn when he is torn between his dreams and the woman he loves.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Super Ranga
programme.desc: Ranga, a reckless thrill-seeker, falls in love with Swathi who makes him promise to be more responsible. However, she breaks up with him when he goes back to his old ways.

programme.title: Dum Man Of Power
programme.desc: A fun-loving Abhiram crosses paths with a timid Uma during a European trip. Before they could express their love for each other, they part ways.

programme.title: Satyabhama
programme.desc: ACP Satyabhama embarks on an investigation into a missing person case, which leads her to uncover dark secrets hidden within the town. However, as she delves deeper, her past begins to haunt her.

programme.title: Kaala Karikalan
programme.desc: Haridev Abhayankar, a corrupt minister, wishes to seize Dharavi's lucrative land for his own gain. However, Karikaalan, the locality's godfather, fights to protect his people's rights and assets.

programme.title: Rajini The Jailer
programme.desc: A retired jailer lives a peaceful life with his family. But when his son, who is a policeman, goes missing and is supposedly killed, he is forced to go back to his world of crime and find the killer.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: Nani discovers a rare antique idol from the excavation site at Amaravati. He wants to sell it and keep the money for himself, but before he can do that, the idol goes missing.

programme.title: Petta
programme.desc: In a bid to save his best friend's son Anwar, hostel warden Kaali goes against local goons. However, everything goes haywire when he is forced to face his past.

programme.title: Etharkkum Thunindhavan
programme.desc: Kannabiran, a lawyer, saves a young woman from a pornography racket run by Inba, a minister's son. However, Inba threatens to leak explicit videos of several women, making Kannabiran go after him.

programme.title: The Return Of Vaastav
programme.desc: Struggling to get by after serving time for patricide, Nandha finds true love and a new lease on life. However, misadventures soon come knocking on his door once again.
